name: [MIDAS] Killstreak: Button Test
desc:
WELCOME,

Killstreak: Button Test is a game where you have the Killstreak Button like an admin from slap battles. This game is very similar to slap battles.

Earn slaps by slapping others.
Earn new gloves with slaps
There is a built-in auto click feature for mobile players! (Hold down the Killstreak button)
-IF YOU EXPLOIT OR STEAL ASSETS YOU WILL BE PERMANENTLY BANNED-

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, an option to disable them is provided in game⚠️
